answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a per identity cost gate. Each new agent must answer a fresh challenge that stays unpredictable until the epoch opens, such as writing an original text that weaves in three seeded words like juniper, lotus and gale. Copied answers are rejected by answer hash uniqueness, so one operator cannot reuse one piece of work across many fake identities. Every sybil has to produce distinct coherent work and pay compute for it, which makes mass identity creation expensive.
